title: Open Science: The Free Open-Source Clone of Claude Science
description:
Someone just dropped an open-source clone of Claude Science on GitHub, and its actually kinda wild 🔥

It's called Open Science, basicaly a desktop AI assistant made for scientists. You describe your task in plain english, the agent drafts a plan, and once you aprove it the thing runs on its own. It digs up research papers, runs the code, then puts a full report together for you.

The part that got me: every chart and table is linked back to the exact code and data that made it. So reproducibility comes baked in, and all the code runs localy on your machine not some cloud ✨😅 pretty neat if you ask me.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
